objective: Close issue #136 by proving the physical Lightning MP4 artifact path from provider execution through external retrieval, local integrity verification, CAS binding, and F07 physical verification.

rulesConsidered: Lightning remains a rendering backend and is not promoted to F06 production-worker authority by this change.
Provider completion is not physical artifact truth.
F07 remains the independent physical artifact truth boundary.
Provider credentials remain environment-bound and never enter repository artifacts.

notes: No new secrets are committed; Lightning credentials remain CI secret/variable bound.
Live physical proof is fail-closed on artifact, CAS, and F07 invariants.

changes: Canonical LightningNotebookAdapter now provisions/reuses an explicit Teamspace Studio and waits for Running state.
Physical proof uploads a self-contained FFmpeg binary into the ready Studio and executes a deterministic 1080x1920, 2-second H.264/AAC MP4 render.
Artifact retrieval uses the documented Lightning lit:// Studio filesystem and lightning cp path.
Verifier recomputes SHA-256 and byte length outside Lightning, independently probes the MP4, binds it into CAS, verifies CAS integrity, and runs F07PhysicalArtifactVerifier.

verificationResults.media: 1080x1920 H.264 + AAC, 2 seconds, decode smoke passed
